purpose: Frozen metric definitions and gates for the coupled turbine plant. Numerical engineering targets, not measured engine error bounds.

analytical_component.definition: |value - closed form| / |closed form| for nozzles (choked, subsonic, ideal, underexpanded, separated) and zero-speed turbomachinery with a calorically perfect gas

algebraic_residual.definition: max scaled residual of the accepted solve; pressures over the speed-similar gauge (design nozzle gauge x N1^2 + ram, floor 1e-3 p0), flows over design flows, torques over design turbine torque, turbine capacity fractions squared

energy_closure_step.definition: |stored - sources| / sum of absolute ledger terms, per accepted step

mass_closure_step.definition: |manifold change - (air in + fuel in - outflow - dump)| / sum of absolute mass terms, per accepted step

energy_closure_cumulative.definition: |sum of step residuals| / sum of step scales over a fixture interval

label_causality.definition: Evaluate() outputs at an identical physical state with only abSelected, abFuelAir command and augment demand changed
label_causality.gate: bit-identical gross thrust, augmentor heat release and station 7 temperature

augmentor_onset.definition: while augmentor burned fuel is zero: gross thrust minus that of the same state with augmentor spray removed
augmentor_onset.gate: <= delivered augmentor spray x nozzle exit velocity + 1e-6 x dry thrust; station 7 temperature <= station 6 while the liner is colder than the gas
augmentor_onset.evidence: replaces the expected failure recorded in 0sfs docs/validation/f135-ab-onset.md (4.1333 s of wet thrust with zero burned augmentor fuel)

reduced_vs_reference.definition: max over a dry acceleration and augmentor light-off of |reduced - component| gross thrust / design thrust, and station 7 temperature difference

event_timing.definition: first published augmentor burn minus the accepted light-off event time

timestep.definition: N1 and gross thrust at 0.5 s and 1.5 s of an idle-to-military acceleration at 60, 120 and 240 Hz against 1920 Hz

work_bound.definition: Newton iterations per accepted step, every solve and fallback included

mixer_conservation.definition: momentum mixer with a calorically perfect gas: relative error of mixed mass, total enthalpy and impulse (W V + Ps A) against the entering streams; uniform streams at one flux mix without loss; mixed entropy is at least the mass-weighted entering entropy

steady_off_design.definition: steady start at 1500 m, Mach 0.4, throttle 0.7, against the same engine after 10 s of transient

thrust_split.definition: lift-fan over main-nozzle gross thrust against the command after 10 s (vanes with the throat at its minimum; throat with the vanes open), the steady solve at the same inputs, and the error remaining 0.5 s after a cut in the command

lp_speed_limit.definition: N1 excess over a limit 0.4 points above the running N1 while the lift-fan door closes with the split following it, with and without the limit
